methods.name: cv_analyzer
methods.description: End-to-end candidate screening: extract a CV and a job offer, analyze the match, then either generate tailored interview questions or draft a courteous refusal email.

methods.name: doc_summarizer
methods.description: Deep document summarization: profile the document and extract importance-ranked key points in parallel, then synthesize a structured summary with themes and open questions.

methods.name: documents
methods.description: Document extraction methods for text, images, and page views.

methods.name: image_generation
methods.description: Image generation methods: render a description directly, or refine it into an optimized image prompt first.

methods.name: invoice_extraction
methods.description: Extract structured invoice data from a document: classify each page as bill or receipt, then extract amounts, VAT, vendor and buyer details using both the OCR text and the page view.

methods.name: slide_designer
methods.description: Turn a rough slide-deck brief into design proposals: polish the brief, generate multiple visual themes, render a mockup image for each, and compose an HTML report presenting them all.

methods.name: table_extraction
methods.description: Extract a data table from a screenshot into faithful HTML, then review the result against the image to correct text and formatting.

methods.name: text_stats
methods.description: Deterministic text statistics computed in pure Python: character, word, sentence and paragraph counts, vocabulary richness, most frequent words, and estimated reading and speaking times, reported as Markdown.

methods.name: tweet_optimizer
methods.description: Optimize a tech tweet: score the draft for fluffiness, cringiness, humblebragging and vagueness, then rewrite it in your own writing style following Twitter/X best practices.
